title: Outdoor Theater Stage & Audience Benches, 1970s B&W Photograph
description: A high-contrast black and white photograph capturing an empty theater or amphitheater stage framed by heavy curtains. In the foreground, empty rows of wooden audience benches face the proscenium stage. Two figures stand near the right side of the stage apron, dressed in 1970s casual attire. The back of the photo is blank.
